allow_metered_uploads.description: Whether to allow uploads over metered (e.g., cellular) network connections.

auto_start_on_charging.description: Whether to automatically start paused uploads when the device begins charging.

backend_enabled.description: Map of backend name → enabled (true/false). Used in conditional sections.

items.description: Per-backend enabled state. If missing, backend is enabled by default.

backend_ftp_tls.description: Map of backend name → use FTPS (only applicable for FTP backend).

items.description: Whether to use implicit FTPS for the FTP backend.
Host or URL for the backend service (e.g., 'example.com', 'https://cloud.example.com').

backend_passwords.description: Map of backend name → password/token. Store securely.

items.description: Password or access token for authentication (if required by backend).

backend_paths.description: Map of backend name → remote path.

items.description: Base remote path/prefix where uploads for this backend are stored.
Username for authentication (if required by backend).

backends.description: List of enabled upload backends. The order does not affect priority.

items.description: Supported upload backends. Each backend must be a lowercase identifier.

cache_path.description: Absolute filesystem path where completed uploads are temporarily cached before being sent.

compress_uploads.description: Whether to compress upload payloads before transmission to reduce bandwidth usage.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of the cache directory. Set to 0 for unlimited size.

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of uploads that can proceed simultaneously.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of automatic retry attempts for a failed upload before giving up.

retry_delay.description: Minimum delay (in seconds) between consecutive retry attempts.
